name: 嗨皮组合 训练家的宝可梦 嗨皮包

description.text: The Happy Pack (嗨皮包) of the Happy Set Trainer's Pokémon of 16 October 2026 is a two-card pack, seven to a box, shared out after the games by the number of games won, as in the two Happy Sets before it. Its 49 cards, 43 Pokémon and three cards each of the Supporters Black Belt's Training and Professor's Research, come as non-holo cards (88.45% of cards), Poké Ball pattern holos (10.5%) and Master Ball pattern holos (1.05%). A pack holds at most one of the cards numbered 044 to 049, the Supporters. They are numbered out of 49.

tell.text: A "CSVH6eC" mark at the bottom left, and a number out of 049
